description: Private on-device search: document ingest, indexing, and retrieval for case files.
config.title: Safe Appeals RAG
config.docParseSidecarUrl: Localhost URL for the Unlimited-OCR DocParse sidecar (HTTP). Override with SAFEAPPEALS_DOCPARSE_URL. Inference never runs in the extension host.
config.localAiSetupCompleted: Whether Private Search (Local AI) setup was finished or skipped on this computer. Machine-scoped; not synced.
tool.indexDocument.modelDescription: Index a workspace document into Private Search (txt/md in v1). Set isCoreReference true for core_reference; otherwise scope follows path (core_references/ → core_reference, else case_index). Returns success/skip/hard-disable message. Does not claim MMR. Re-index overwrites the same docId when already present.
tool.indexDocument.userDescription: Index a document for private search
tool.searchReference.modelDescription: Hybrid private search over core_reference (workspace core_references/). Retrieval: BM25 + vector → RRF → optional cross-encoder (not MMR). Returns a citation-aware contextPack. Use limit for finalK (default 8).
tool.searchWorkspace.modelDescription: Hybrid private search over case_index. Retrieval: BM25 + vector → RRF → optional cross-encoder (not MMR). Returns a citation-aware contextPack. Use limit for finalK (default 8).
tool.searchAll.modelDescription: Hybrid private search across all scopes (core_reference + case_index). Retrieval: BM25 + vector → RRF → optional cross-encoder (not MMR). Returns a citation-aware contextPack. Use limit for finalK (default 8).
tool.getStats.modelDescription: Return Private Search index stats (documents, chunks, vectors, BM25 text docs) and honest retrieval tips. No parameters.
